changelog:
- v0.5.0 NEW: Mano Magica - guided hand-tracking tour (pinch a bud until it blooms, grab/throw petals, sculpt clay, conduct bells, pet an alebrije)\n- v0.5.0 NEW: Gran Baile Espejo - three calavera dancers mirror your real body moves via body tracking (hands-only/auto-dance fallbacks)\n- v0.5.0 PAUSE: universal pause/exit overlay - Menu button/Esc/floating button in every chapter + experience (Resume/Restart/Controls/Quit), freezes gameplay, laser+pinch+gaze+mouse\n- v0.5.0 OFRENDA PROPS: full in-house Blender ofrenda set — pan de muerto hero loaves, tall/mid/short candles with flame VFX wired to FlameAnchors, painted calavera skulls, ornate photo frames, tileable marigold garland
- v0.5.0 OFRENDA VIVA: finishing ch1 triggers nightfall - photos ignite with chimes + names, 5 beat-synced calavera dancers, petal ceiling fall, dancer's bow, amber candlelight grade\n- v0.5.0 BEAT SYNC: El Gran Baile troupe + leader now hop/sway/spin on the 120 BPM beat\n- v0.5.0 WEATHER ANSWERS GAMEPLAY: rain ripples ch2 bridge water, wind gusts push Guitarra petals + ripple banners + dim ch5 finale in storms\n- v0.5.0 TRANSITIONS: petal-fall curtain between chapters; ambient butterflies + horizon spirits in every chapter + experience\n- v0.5.0 CONTROLLER SKINS: styled virtual controllers with per-experience accessories + Controls legend card (pause menu Controls page)\n- v0.5.0 TECH: Android targetSdk 34\n- v0.4.0 LIVING SKY: MarigoldSky dynamic atmosphere - full day/night cycle with graded sunrise/sunset, procedural sky shader (sun, stars, moon, drifting clouds), simulated realistic weather (clear/partly/overcast/rain/thunderstorm/fog/windy) with smooth cross-fades, GPU rain, lightning + procedural thunder, distance fog, windblown leaves. Time-of-day selector in menu (Dawn/Day/Sunset/Night/Auto, default golden sunset). Global wind system drives papel picado ripple, flower sway, lantern flicker, petals. Realistic physics pass: plaza/chapter props now tip, tumble and collide (Quest-perf capped). Guitarra Mexicana keeps gentle weather while you play.\n- v0.3.0 MENU FIX: launch menu rebuilt as a 2D panel - the old 3D-button menu could not be clicked on Quest 3 (no pointer, mouse-only input). Quest controller laser pointers (trigger = click, always visible) + hand-tracking pinch select + desktop mouse fallback. Chapter select for all 5 chapters, AR mode toggle, Check for Updates built in.
- v0.3.0 NEW: Guitarra Mexicana - rhythm-strum + free-play folk guitar game in a lantern-lit plaza (original waltz composition, nylon-string plucks, score/combo, pinch-orbs to choose mode)
- MARIGOLD v0.1.0: a 10-minute Dia de Muertos journey in 5 chapters
- The Ofrenda: hand-place marigolds, photos and candles; pinch to light each flame
- The Marigold Bridge: cross a glowing petal bridge over luminous water
- Plaza de los Alebrijes: meet glowing spirit-animal guides, feed them light orbs
- Papel Picado Canopy: wave hands to ripple giant cut-paper banners
- El Gran Baile: follow-the-leader hand dance finale with petal fireworks
- Bonus guitar corner: strum plucked strings with hand distance
- Immersive mode + AR living-room mode (passthrough, anchored ofrenda)
- Original procedural folk-inspired score, Check for Updates built in
- v0.2.0 VISUAL UPGRADE: real CC0 3D models replace primitives (Kenney) - carved stone arches, real marigold flowers, paper lanterns, skeleton dancers, fountain, ghosts
- Controller haptics: feel candle lighting, feeding guides, dance moves
- Vivid HDR-look rendering: ACES tone mapping, stronger bloom, atmospheric fog
